title: 2026 VMAs Reports 11-Year Viewership High
summary: The show delivered 8.43 million viewers, up 51% from last year.
contentText:
The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards on CBS and simulcast on MTV delivered 8.43 million viewers, making it the most-watched VMAs since 2015 and up +51% from the 2025 awards show, according to figures reported by CBS.

Related

Madonna Opens 2026 VMAs With Star-Studded Set Featuring Sabrina Carpenter, Charli xcx, Seth Rogen & More

Hosted by Snoop Dogg and broadcast live from Los Angeles’ Peacock Theater, the 2026 VMAs ceremony was dominated by awards to Madonna and Taylor Swift . The awards show posted its largest viewership in key adults 25-54, adults 18-49 and adults 18-34 demos in years, with all audience demos up more than +30% from last year. The telecast peaked with over 15 million viewers across CBS and MTV in the opening act, which featured Madonna’s first VMAs performance in 23 years, including a show-opening medley with Sabrina Carpenter and Charli XCX .

The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards telecast was scheduled to run from 7:30 to 9:30 p.m. ET / 4:30 to 6:30 p.m. PT, though the on-air broadcast experienced a delay of about 20 to 22 minutes on CBS due to an NFL game running late.

The ratings seem to vindicate the key creative decisions around the show – a tight, streamlined format (it was about half the length of the Grammys and the Oscars); and a focus on household names, and legacy acts in several cases, over the latest and hottest attractions. Nirvana , a band that disbanded in 1994, received the video vanguard award. George Michael , who died in 2016, was honored with an extensive hits medley. There was also a simple tribute to Dolly Parton , who died last month, as there has been and likely will be on many more awards shows.

Madonna and Swift were both on hand to receive awards. Madonna opened the show with a lively, star-studded performance, but Swift didn’t perform, opting to introduce her new video instead. The show aired a clip of Bruno Mars performing in a recent concert. Two of the night’s other biggest winners, BTS and Ariana Grande , had no role in the show.

Ratings Highlights:

- Best same-day audience since 2015 (12.73m).

- The 2026 VMAs delivered 8.43 million viewers on CBS and MTV, with an encore on MTV, up +51% from the Sunday, Sept. 7, 2025, event that also ran on CBS and MTV, with an encore on MTV (from 5.60m). 

- CBS averaged 7.61 million viewers, up +52% from last year (5.00m).

- MTV’s simulcast averaged 686,000 viewers, up +40% from last year (491K).

- MTV’s encore averaged 142,000 viewers, up +31% from last year (108K).

- The show posted its largest A25-54, A18-49 and A18-34 audiences in years.

- Most-watched VMAs in the A25-54 demo since 2019 (3.55m), amassing 3.11 million demo viewers, up +34%from last year (2.32m).

- Most-watched VMAs in A18-49 since 2018 (3.02m), averaging 2.66 million demo viewers, up +32% from last year (2.02m).

- Most-watched VMAs in A18-34 since 2020 (1.14m), averaging 1.09 million viewers in the demo, up +46% from last year (751K).

Source: Nielsen Live+SD Data, 2026 Panel-Only Fast Nationals- Inclusive of Out of Home; Nielsen 09/07/26

Social Highlights:

- The VMAs ranked as the day’s most social show with 31.1 million interactions and 159 million video views, with video views increasing +8% from last year.

- The VMAs reached #1 worldwide on X, trended across 10 countries and generated 18 related trending topics.

Source: Social Content Ratings, GetDayTrends and Trends24, 09/27/26

The 2026 VMAs were produced by Gunpowder & Sky. Van Toffler served as producer. Toffler discussed the key creative decisions surrounding the show with Billboard ‘s Andrew Unterberger in two Q&A’s that run last week.

Jesse Ignjatovic of Den of Thieves, Barb Bialkowski and Bruce Gillmer served as executive producers alongside Barry Barclay and Floris Bauer. Melanie Block served as co-executive producer and Gary Lanvy as co-producer. Snoop Dogg was executive producer alongside producers Sara Ramaker and Jasmin Ratansi. Jen Proctor was executive talent producer.
